questions.passage: Born in Bernezzo, Italy in 1943, Sister Carla became a nun at the age of 19 and ended up ⓐ caring for more than 120 war orphans. She added, "I also became a nun because I wanted to ⓑ fulfill the dream of my late brother, ⓒ which wanted to become a priest but passed away before he could." The 25-year-old Sister Carla came to Korea in 1968 after ⓓ hearing about many war orphans and Hansen's patients in Korea. She accepted the pain of those patients ⓔ as her own.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [원문] the dream of my late brother, which wanted to become a priest [해석] 사제가 되고 싶었지만 그러기 전에 세상을 떠난 돌아가신 오빠의 꿈. 선행사가 사람(my late brother)이므로 관계대명사 which가 아닌 who를 사용해야 합니다.
det.correct: ⓐ caring: end up + v-ing(~하게 되다) 구문으로 동명사 caring은 올바릅니다 ✅ ⓑ fulfill: wanted to fulfill에서 to부정사 뒤 동사원형 fulfill은 올바릅니다 ✅ ⓒ which: 선행사가 my late brother(사람)이므로 who를 써야 합니다. which는 사물·동물에만 사용 → 어법상 어색 ❌ ⓓ hearing: 전치사 after 뒤에 동명사 hearing이 온 것은 올바릅니다 ✅ ⓔ as: accept A as B 구문의 전치사 as는 올바릅니다 ✅
det.tip: 🔑 관계대명사 선택: 선행사가 사람 → who/whom/whose, 사물·동물 → which, 사람+사물 → that. 콤마 뒤 계속적 용법에서도 사람이면 who. 비교: end up + v-ing(~하게 되다) vs. end up + 형용사

questions.passage: She raised pigs with the patients to help them become economically independent. She started to learn Korean so she could understand each individual's problems more deeply. She struggled with the language at first, but after about two years, she was able to communicate with local people freely and truly (A) [understand / understanding] the patients' specific challenges. Additionally, she went to a hospital in Spain (B) [to study / studying] Hansen's disease and earn a nurse's assistant certification. When she first began (C) [treating / to treat] Hansen's patients, she was able to treat them with only the small amount of medicine she received from German aid agencies.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [원문] truly understand the patients' specific challenges / went to a hospital in Spain to study / began treating [해석] 환자들의 구체적인 어려움을 진정으로 이해하다 / 한센병을 연구하기 위해 스페인의 병원에 갔다 / 한센병 환자를 치료하기 시작했다. (A) and로 연결된 병렬 구조에서 communicate와 대등하게 동사원형 understand. (B) 목적을 나타내는 부사적 용법의 to부정사. (C) begin + 동명사.
det.correct: ① understand - to study - treating: (A) was able to communicate ... and understand → 병렬 구조 ✅ (B) 목적의 to부정사 ✅ (C) begin + v-ing ✅ → 정답 ✅ ② understanding은 and 병렬 구조 위반 ❌ ③ studying은 목적 부사적 용법이 아님 ❌ ④ (A)(B) 둘 다 오류 ❌ ⑤ (C) to treat도 가능하지만 원문은 treating ❌
det.tip: 🔑 병렬 구조: and/or/but으로 연결된 요소는 문법적 형태가 같아야 합니다. was able to [communicate] and [understand] → 둘 다 동사원형. begin/start + v-ing = begin/start + to-v. 목적의 to부정사: go/come + to-v

questions.passage: "The saddest thing at the time was not the fact that there was a lack of medicine, but the prejudice towards the Hansen's patients. Because of that, the children of Hansen's patients were not ⓐ accepted by normal schools," Sister Carla said. So she ⓑ founded a school for the children of Hansen's patients in the village. Otherwise, more than a hundred children ⓒ wouldn't have received proper education. Her love for the Hansen's patients is also ⓓ reflecting in her Korean name, "Kang Kalla."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓓ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [원문] Her love for the Hansen's patients is also reflected in her Korean name [해석] 한센병 환자들에 대한 사랑은 한국 이름에도 반영되어 있다. 주어 Her love는 '반영되는' 대상이므로 수동태 is reflected가 되어야 합니다.
det.correct: ⓐ accepted: be + p.p. 수동태. 아이들이 '받아들여지지 않았다' → were not accepted ✅ ⓑ founded: '설립했다'는 과거형. found-founded-founded(설립하다) vs. find-found-found(찾다) ✅ ⓒ wouldn't have received: Otherwise = 가정법 과거완료 → would(n't) have p.p. ✅ ⓓ reflecting: 주어 Her love가 '반영되는' 대상 → 수동태 is reflected 필요. is reflecting(능동 진행)은 어색 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 능동 vs. 수동: 주어가 동작을 '하는' 쪽 → 능동, '당하는' 쪽 → 수동. reflect: 능동(~을 반영하다) vs. be reflected in(~에 반영되다). founded(설립했다) ≠ found(찾았다). Otherwise + would have p.p. = 가정법 과거완료

questions.passage: Back then, people (A) [excluded / included] Hansen's patients from the general public due to various prejudices. People falsely believed that Hansen's disease was highly (B) [contagious / courageous], and also felt uncomfortable with the appearance of Hansen's patients. Nowhere was the place for those patients, and their (C) [miserable / memorable] lives were passed on to their own children.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 어휘로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [원문] people excluded Hansen's patients / highly contagious / miserable lives [해석] 사람들은 환자들을 배제했다 / 전염성이 높다 / 비참한 삶. 편견으로 '배제', 질병이 '전염성' 있다고 잘못 믿음, '비참한' 삶이 대물림.
det.correct: ① excluded - contagious - miserable: 문맥상 모두 적절 ✅ ② included(포함)는 편견으로 배제하는 맥락에 부적절 ❌ ③ courageous(용감한)는 질병 성질 설명에 부적절 ❌ ④ included + courageous 둘 다 부적절 ❌ ⑤ memorable(기억에 남는)은 비참한 삶 맥락에 부적절 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 exclude A from B(A를 B에서 배제) ↔ include A in B. contagious(전염성의) ≈ infectious ↔ non-contagious. miserable(비참한) ≈ wretched ↔ memorable(기억할 만한). courageous(용감한) ≈ brave

questions.passage: Sister Carla did her best to be there for anyone who needed her help, but sadly she didn't have enough time to care for herself. She devoted everything she had to the sick, lonely, and poor while she lived very ③ lavishly. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [원문] while she lived very frugally [해석] 매우 검소하게 생활했다. 원문 frugally(검소하게) → ③ lavishly(사치스럽게)는 정반대 의미. 30년 된 시계, 짧은 연필 등 검소한 삶의 맥락에서 부적절.
det.correct: ① properly(제대로): 류머티즘을 '제대로' 치료하지 못함 ✅ ② twisted(뒤틀린): 발가락이 심하게 '뒤틀렸다' ✅ ③ lavishly(사치스럽게): 원문 frugally(검소하게)와 정반대 → 부적절 ❌ ④ shorter(더 짧은): 새끼손가락보다 '더 짧은' 연필 ✅ ⑤ tiny(작은): 같은 '작은' 집 50년 ✅
det.tip: 🔑 frugally(검소하게) ≈ thriftily, economically ↔ lavishly(사치스럽게) ≈ extravagantly, luxuriously. 반의어 함정: 주변 근거(30-year-old watch, pencils shorter than her little finger, same tiny home)에서 '검소함' 파악

det.ref: [원문] she devoted her life to caring for patients [해석] 환자들을 돌보는 데 삶을 바쳤다. 원문 devoted(헌신했다) → ③ neglected(방치했다)는 정반대 의미.
det.correct: ① remarkable(뛰어난): 자기 희생하는 '뛰어난' 개인 ✅ ② excellent(훌륭한): '훌륭한' 예시 ✅ ③ neglected(방치했다): 원문 devoted와 정반대. '방치했다'는 문맥에 안 맞음 ❌ ④ noble(고귀한): 동등하게 '고귀한' 인간 ✅ ⑤ accepted(받아들였다): 고통을 자신의 것으로 '받아들였다' ✅
det.tip: 🔑 devote A to B(A를 B에 바치다) ≈ dedicate A to B ↔ neglect(방치하다) ≈ ignore, disregard. devote oneself to + 명사/동명사. remarkable ≈ outstanding, notable. noble ≈ dignified, honorable

questions.passage: Born in Bernezzo, Italy in 1943, Sister Carla became a nun at the age of 19 and ended up caring for more than 120 war orphans. The 25-year-old Sister Carla came to Korea in 1968 after hearing about many war orphans and Hansen's patients in Korea. For Sister Carla, however, Hansen's patients were equally noble human beings. She started to learn Korean so she could understand each individual's problems more deeply. det.ref: [원문 요약] 돼지 사육(경제적) + 학교 설립(교육적) + 한국어 학습으로 소통(사회적). [해석] 의료적 필요뿐만 아니라 경제적·교육적·사회적 안녕도 다뤘습니다.
det.correct: ① religious beliefs: 환자 지원 맥락에서 언급 없음 ❌ ② economic, educational, and social well-being: 돼지(경제) + 학교(교육) + 소통(사회) → 정확히 일치 ✅ ③ political rights: 언급 없음 ❌ ④ international fame: 수녀의 목적 아님 ❌ ⑤ personal hobbies: 글과 무관 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 빈칸 추론: not only A but also B에서 B를 추론. 의료 외 지원 사례를 종합. well-being(안녕, 복지) ≈ welfare. address(다루다) ≈ deal with, tackle

det.ref: [원문] we all can make a difference and that through our actions we can bring about a positive change ... also bring us happiness. [해석] 우리의 행동으로 긍정적 변화를 가져오고 행복을 가져다준다.

det.tip: 🔑 that절 빈칸: reminds us(상기시킨다)와 연결. 글 전체 교훈을 담는 문장이 정답. bring about(초래하다) ≈ cause, lead to. make a difference(변화를 만들다)

questions.passage: Sister Carla did her best to be there for anyone who needed her help, but sadly she didn't have enough time to care for herself. She developed rheumatism but didn't treat the disease properly because she was busy working for her patients. As a result, her toes became severely twisted. Her twisted toes reminded her neighbors of ginger roots, and so they called her toes "ginger feet." She devoted everything she had to the sick, lonely, and poor while she lived very frugally.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 "ginger feet"이 함축하는 바로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [원문] developed rheumatism but didn't treat properly because busy working for patients → toes severely twisted [해석] 류머티즘이지만 환자 돌봄으로 치료 못해 발가락이 뒤틀림. '생강 발'은 헌신의 물리적 대가를 함축.
det.correct: ① 건강한 식단: 생강과 식단 무관 ❌ ② 타인 헌신의 흔적: 환자 돌봄으로 자기 병 방치 → 뒤틀린 발가락 = 헌신의 대가 ✅ ③ 생강 농사: 비유일 뿐 실제 농사 아님 ❌ ④ 시대적 한계: 치료 못한 이유는 환자 돌봄 때문 ❌ ⑤ 치료 부작용: 치료를 '안 한' 결과 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 함축 의미: 비유적 표현의 원인(류머티즘 방치)과 근본 원인(환자 헌신)을 연결. ginger feet = 뒤틀린 발가락 = 자기 희생의 증거. frugally(검소하게) ≈ thriftily

questions.passage:
[주어진 글] Sister Carla wanted to help the Hansen's patients in as many ways as she could.

(A) Additionally, she went to a hospital in Spain to study Hansen's disease and earn a nurse's assistant certification.

(B) She raised pigs with the patients to help them become economically independent.

(C) She started to learn Korean so she could understand each individual's problems more deeply. She struggled with the language at first, but after about two years, she was able to communicate with local people freely.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [원문 순서] She raised pigs(B) → She started to learn Korean(C) → Additionally, she went to Spain(A). [해석] 경제적 자립(돼지 사육) → 한국어 학습(2년) → 추가로 스페인 병원 한센병 연구.
det.correct: ① (A)→(B)→(C): Additionally로 시작하는 (A)가 맨 앞에 올 수 없음 ❌ ② (B)→(A)→(C): 한국어 학습이 스페인 이후가 되어 어색 ❌ ③ (B)→(C)→(A): 경제적 도움 → 언어 학습 → 추가 의료 자격. Additionally가 마지막에서 추가 정보 ✅ ④ 순서 부자연스러움 ❌ ⑤ 순서 부자연스러움 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 순서 배열: ① 연결사 단서 — Additionally(게다가)는 앞에 내용 필요 → 첫 번째 불가. ② 논리적 순서: 경제 지원 → 소통 능력 → 전문 지식. Additionally ≈ Furthermore, Moreover

questions.passage: In addition to helping the surviving Hansen's patients, she continued to care for the elderly every day. ① Even in her old age, she took them to the hospital, did their dishes, and took care of problems at the bank for them. ② She even went grocery shopping for them. ③ The Italian economy experienced rapid growth during the post-war period due to industrial development. ④ She used every bit of her time for those in need. ⑤ She continued working in the community, running a pottery-making program, and sold pottery to help senior citizens in poor neighborhoods.

1. 가정법 과거완료(Otherwise, ~ would have p.p.)를 사용할 것

우리말: 그렇지 않았다면, 백 명이 넘는 아이들이 제대로 된 교육을 받지 못했을 것이다.

det.ref: [원문] Otherwise, more than a hundred children wouldn't have received proper education. [해석] 그렇지 않았다면, 백 명이 넘는 아이들이 제대로 된 교육을 받지 못했을 것이다. Otherwise = 가정법 과거완료.
det.correct: 핵심: Otherwise, S + would(n't) have + p.p. = 가정법 과거완료(과거 사실의 반대). receive → received(과거분사). more than a hundred = 백 명이 넘는. proper education = 제대로 된 교육.
det.tip: 🔑 가정법 과거완료: If S had p.p., S would have p.p. = Otherwise, S would have p.p. otherwise = if it had not been so. 부정: wouldn't have p.p. = would not have p.p.

"I thought that instead of starting a family and caring for my own children only, I could devote my life to (care) for more children."

det.ref: [원문] devote my life to caring for more children [해석] 더 많은 아이들을 돌보는 데 삶을 바칠 수 있었다. devote A to B에서 to는 전치사 → 동명사(caring).
det.correct: devote A to B에서 to는 전치사(to부정사의 to 아님) → 뒤에 동명사(v-ing). care → caring ✅. to care(X)는 이 구문에서 어법에 맞지 않음.
det.tip: 🔑 devote A to + v-ing: to가 전치사. 비교: be devoted to + v-ing, be committed to + v-ing, be accustomed to + v-ing, look forward to + v-ing → 모두 to 뒤에 동명사
